extractionMethod: Originally read by eye off zoomed screenshots (no DXF was available at the time -- see docs/design-decisions.md, 'Extraction method hierarchy'). Later re-verified against a real DXF (converted from the source DWG via ODA File Converter) using src/extraction/dxf-search.ts: every value below matches the DXF's exact source text exactly (EXG'T LAST MH new T.L 110.450, EXG'T LAST IC new T.L 110.460, both RC SUMP callout texts) -- the original manual reading was accurate, now confirmed rather than assumed.
extractionConfidence: Cross-validated against exact DXF source text (see extractionMethod). See docs/design-decisions.md "Confidence scoring" for what the per-verdict confidence numbers represent.

buildingVsSewerChecks.notes: The plan draws an explicit '1M SEWER SETBACK LINE' next to the existing sewer, so requiredSetback_m=1 is known. sewerCenterline/buildingFootprint are still null: a real DXF now exists for this drawing (converted via ODA File Converter), and it does contain LWPOLYLINE geometry that dxf-parser-style tooling can read, but extracting the *specific* polylines for the sewer centerline and the building footprint (as opposed to reading text) has not been implemented yet -- see docs/rules/ssw-1.2.4-a-no-structure-over-sewer.md. Not a hard blocker anymore, just unfinished. The building appears, by eye, to stay outside the setback line in the screenshots reviewed, but that is not a computed distance and is not reported as one.
